1 --- 2 name: officecli 3 version: "1.0.94" 4 description: "OfficeCLI — 统一 Office 文档解析与操作 CLI 工具。支持 docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf/doc/eml 等格式的创建、读取、修改，是 pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx/canvas 五个 skill 的合集升级。适用于需要精准定位单元格/段落/幻灯片路径、或跨格式操作的复杂场景，如 DTRB 评审 PPT 内嵌 OLE 附件提取与解析。" 5 license: Apache-2.0 6 repository: https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/tree/main 7 install: Local binary — see Install section below 8 --- 9 10 # OfficeCLI Skill 11 12 **OfficeCLI** 是一个 CLI 工具，提供对 Office 文档（Word/Excel/PPT/PDF/邮件）的统一创建、读取、修改能力。它封装了 python-docx、openpyxl、python-pptx、pdfplumber 等底层库，提供更精准的路径定位和结构化输出。 13 14 > 项目地址：[iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/tree/main) 15 > 下载地址：[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases) 16 > 当前版本：v1.0.94 17 18 ## PPTX 矢量 SVG 导出 19 20 **officecli 自带 SVG 导出（`officecli view svg`）对华为定制主题 PPT 存在配色丢失问题**：华为主题的 `clrScheme` 将 `lt1`(bg1) 设为 `#666666`、`dk2`(bg2) 设为 `#FFFFFF`（与标准主题相反），officecli 误将 scheme:bg1 解析为白色，导致底色和背景高亮丢失。 21 22 **解决方案：** 使用 `scripts/pptx2svg.py` 脚本，走 **PPTX → PDF (PowerPoint COM) → SVG (PyMuPDF)** 路径，完整保留底色、背景高亮和每个元素为独立可选中矢量路径。 23 24 ```bash 25 uv run python src/skills/officecli/scripts/pptx2svg.py [output_dir] 26 ``` 27 28 | 平台 | PPTX→PDF | PDF→SVG | 说明 | 29 |---|---|---|---| 30 | **Windows** | PowerPoint COM (pywin32) | PyMuPDF | 完整保真，含华为定制主题 | 31 | **Linux** | LibreOffice headless | PyMuPDF | 已实现，需 `apt install libreoffice` | 32 33 **平台差异（必须了解）：** 34 35 | 维度 | Windows (PowerPoint COM) | Linux (LibreOffice headless) | 36 |---|---|---| 37 | **华为主题保真** | ✅ 完整支持 `clrScheme` 定制主题 | ⚠️ 部分主题可能渲染偏差，建议验证 | 38 | **字体替换** | 使用系统已安装字体 | 需安装对应字体（如 `fonts-wqy-microhei` 用于中文） | 39 | **Group icon 补注入** | ✅ 支持 | ✅ 支持（共用同一套 PPTX 提取逻辑） | 40 | **性能** | ~2-5s/页 | ~3-8s/页（受 CPU 影响） | 41 | **依赖** | pywin32（已含） | libreoffice（需单独安装） | 42 43 **Linux 安装 LibreOffice：** 44 45 ```bash 46 # Debian/Ubuntu 47 sudo apt install libreoffice fonts-wqy-microhei 48 49 # RHEL/CentOS/Fedora 50 sudo dnf install libreoffice langpacks-zh_CN 51 52 # Alpine (Docker) 53 apk add libreoffice ttf-wqy-zenhei 54 ``` 55 56 输出产物：单个 `index.html` 文件，6 页矢量 SVG 直接内嵌（每页元素可单独选中，无需额外 SVG 文件）。 57 58 **转换要求（必须遵守）：** 59 60 1. **文字保留为 `` 元素** — PyMuPDF `get_svg_image(text_as_path=0)`，禁止将文字转成 path 描边（默认 `text_as_path=1` 会导致文字不可选、不可搜索、渲染异常） 61 2. **字体映射** — PyMuPDF 将系统字体替换为 `Nimbus Sans`，必须替换回 `Microsoft YaHei`（`s.replace("Nimbus Sans", "Microsoft YaHei")`），否则 Windows 浏览器无法渲染英文字符 62 3. **SVG 内嵌到 HTML** — 所有页面的 SVG 直接嵌入单个 `index.html`，不生成独立的 `.svg` 文件 63 4. **多页 ID 防冲突** — 多页 SVG 内嵌时，`id` 和 `url(#)` 引用自动加 slide 前缀（`s1_`, `s2_`, ...） 64 5. **华为主题保真** — 走 COM 导出 PDF 路径，确保定制 `clrScheme`（如 lt1=#666666）的底色和背景高亮正确渲染 65 66 依赖：`pywin32`（已含 pyproject.toml）、`pymupdf`（已含 pyproject.toml） 67 68 ## 与 uniEx 现有 Skills 的关系 69 70 OfficeCLI 是 `src/skills/` 下 pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx/canvas 五个 skill 的**合集升级**： 71 72 | 现有 Skill | OfficeCLI 对应能力 | uniEx 使用场景 | 73 |---|---|---| 74 | `pdf/` | `officecli view text` + `officecli get` | PDF 文本提取、表单解析 | 75 | `docx/` | `officecli view outline` + `officecli get /body/tbl[N]` | Word 标题层级、表格精准提取 | 76 | `pptx/` | `officecli view slides` + 嵌入附件提取 | PPT 幻灯片、OLE 对象解析 | 77 | `xlsx/` | `officecli view stats` + `officecli query /Sheet1/*` | Excel 逐单元格路径定位 | 78 | `canvas/` | `officecli create` | 文档创建（uniEx 暂不使用） | 79 80 **uniEx 中优先使用 OfficeCLI 的场景：** 81 - DTRB PPT 内嵌 OLE 附件提取与递归解析 82 - 需要精准路径定位的深度解析（如 `/body/tbl[1]/tr[2]/tc[3]/p[@paraId=xxx]`） 83 - 跨格式嵌入对象识别（OLE → MSG/ZIP/RAR） 84 85 **保留现有 Skill 的场景：** 86 - openpyxl 直接操作单元格（证据粒度控制更精细） 87 - pdfplumber 表格识别（无需额外安装） 88 - 批量自动化 pipeline（officecli 适合交互式，pipeline 用 Python API 更高效） 89 90 --- 91 92 # officecli 93 94 AI-friendly CLI for .docx, .xlsx, .pptx. Single binary, no dependencies, no Office installation needed. 95 96 ## Install 97 98 ### 本地 binary（推荐，华为内网免外网访问） 99 100 Binary 存放在 `src/skills/officecli/reference/` 目录，按平台区分： 101 102 | 平台 | 文件 | 安装命令 | 103 |---|---|---| 104 | **Windows x64** | `officecli-win-x64.exe` | `cp src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-win-x64.exe /usr/local/bin/officecli.exe && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/officecli.exe` | 105 | **Linux ARM64** | `officecli-linux-arm64` | `cp src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-linux-arm64 /usr/local/bin/officecli && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/officecli` | 106 107 Verify: `officecli --version` 108 109 ### 从 GitHub Releases 下载更新 110 111 访问 [iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI Releases](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases) 下载对应平台的 binary，替换 `reference/` 目录下的文件： 112 113 | 平台 | Releases 中的文件名 | 替换目标 | 114 |---|---|---| 115 | **Windows x64** | `officecli-win-x64.exe` | `src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-win-x64.exe` | 116 | **Linux ARM64** | `officecli-linux-arm64` | `src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-linux-arm64` | 117 118 ```bash 119 # 下载最新 release（需外网访问，替换 为实际版本号） 120 TAG="1.0.94" 121 cd src/skills/officecli/reference 122 123 # Windows x64 124 curl -fSL -o officecli-win-x64.exe "https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases/download/${TAG}/officecli-win-x64.exe" 125 126 # Linux ARM64 127 curl -fSL -o officecli-linux-arm64 "https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases/download/${TAG}/officecli-linux-arm64" 128 chmod +x officecli-linux-arm64 129 ``` 130 131 下载替换后重新执行上面的本地安装命令即可。更新版本后需同步修改本文件 frontmatter 的 `version` 字段。 132 133 --- 134 135 ## Strategy 136 137 **L1 (read) → L2 (DOM edit) → L3 (raw XML)**. Always prefer higher layers. Add `--json` for structured output. 138 139 **Before doc work, check Specialized Skills** (bottom of this file). Fundraising decks, academic papers, financial models, dashboards, and Morph animations need their own skill loaded first — `load_skill` once, then proceed. 140 141 --- 142 143 ## Help System (IMPORTANT) 144 145 **When unsure about property names, value formats, or command syntax, ALWAYS run help instead of guessing.** One help query beats guess-fail-retry loops. 146 147 `officecli help` ≡ `officecli --help`, and `officecli --help` ≡ `officecli help ` — same content. 148 149 ```bash 150 officecli help # All commands + global options + schema entry points 151 officecli help docx # List all docx elements 152 officecli help docx paragraph # Full schema: properties, aliases, examples, readbacks 153 officecli help docx set paragraph # Verb-filtered: only props usable with `set` 154 officecli help docx paragraph --json # Structured schema (machine-readable) 155 ``` 156 157 Format aliases: `word`→`docx`, `excel`→`xlsx`, `ppt`/`powerpoint`→`pptx`. Verbs: `add`, `set`, `get`, `query`, `remove`. MCP exposes the same schema via `{"command":"help","format":"docx","type":"paragraph"}`. 158 159 --- 160 161 ## Performance: Resident Mode 162 163 **Every command auto-starts a resident on first access** (60s idle timeout) — file-lock conflicts are automatically avoided. Explicit `open`/`close` is still recommended for longer sessions (12min idle): 164 ```bash 165 officecli open report.docx # explicitly keep in memory 166 officecli set report.docx ... # no file I/O overhead 167 officecli close report.docx # save and release 168 ``` 169 170 Opt out of auto-start: `OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_RESIDENT=1`. 171 172 --- 173 174 ## Quick Start 175 176 **PPT:** 177 ```bash 178 officecli create slides.pptx 179 officecli add slides.pptx / --type slide --prop title="Q4 Report" --prop background=1A1A2E 180 officecli add slides.pptx '/slide[1]' --type shape --prop text="Revenue grew 25%" --prop x=2cm --prop y=5cm --prop font=Arial --prop size=24 --prop color=FFFFFF 181 ``` 182 183 **Word:** 184 ```bash 185 officecli create report.docx 186 officecli add report.docx /body --type paragraph --prop text="Executive Summary" --prop style=Heading1 187 officecli add report.docx /body --type paragraph --prop text="Revenue increased by 25% year-over-year." 188 ``` 189 190 **Excel:** 191 ```bash 192 officecli create data.xlsx 193 officecli set data.xlsx /Sheet1/A1 --prop value="Name" --prop bold=true 194 officecli set data.xlsx /Sheet1/A2 --prop value="Alice" 195 ``` 196 197 --- 198 199 ## L1: Create, Read & Inspect 200 201 ```bash 202 officecli create # Create blank .docx/.xlsx/.pptx (type from extension) 203 officecli view # outline | stats | issues | text | annotated | html 204 officecli get --depth N # Get a node and its children [--json] 205 officecli query # CSS-like query 206 officecli validate # Validate against OpenXML schema 207 ``` 208 209 ### view modes 210 211 | Mode | Description | Useful flags | 212 |------|-------------|-------------| 213 | `outline` | Document structure | | 214 | `stats` | Statistics (pages, words, shapes) | | 215 | `issues` | Formatting/content/structure problems | `--type format\|content\|structure`, `--limit N` | 216 | `text` | Plain text extraction | `--start N --end N`, `--max-lines N` | 217 | `annotated` | Text with formatting annotations | | 218 | `html` | Static HTML snapshot — same renderer as `watch`, no server needed | `--browser`, `--page N` (docx), `--start N --end N` (pptx) | 219 220 Use `view html` for one-shot snapshots (CI artifacts, archival, diffing); use `watch` when you need live refresh or browser-side click-to-select. 221 222 ### get 223 224 Any XML path via element localName. Use `--depth N` to expand children. Add `--json` for structured output. Default text output is grep-friendly: `path (type) "text" key=val key=val ...` 225 226 ```bash 227 officecli get report.docx '/body/p[3]' --depth 2 --json 228 officecli get slides.pptx '/slide[1]' --depth 1 # list all shapes on slide 1 229 officecli get data.xlsx '/Sheet1/B2' --json 230 ``` 231 232 ### Stable ID Addressing 233 234 Elements with stable IDs return `@attr=value` paths instead of positional indices. Prefer these in multi-step workflows — positional indices shift on insert/delete, stable IDs do not. 235 236 ``` 237 /slide[1]/shape[@id=550950021] # PPT shape 238 /slide[1]/table[@id=1388430425]/tr[1]/tc[2] # PPT table 239 /body/p[@paraId=1A2B3C4D] # Word paragraph 240 /comments/comment[@commentId=1] # Word comment 241 ``` 242 243 PPT also accepts `@name=` (e.g. `shape[@name=Title 1]`), with morph `!!` prefix awareness. Elements without stable IDs (slide, run, tr/tc, row) fall back to positional indices. 244 245 ### query 246 247 CSS-like selectors: `[attr=value]`, `[attr!=value]`, `[attr~=text]`, `[attr>=value]`, `[attr<=value]`, `:contains("text")`, `:empty`, `:has(formula)`, `:no-alt`. 248 249 ```bash 250 officecli query report.docx 'paragraph[style=Normal] > run[font!=Arial]' 251 officecli query slides.pptx 'shape[fill=FF0000]' 252 ``` 253 254 For large documents, use `--max-lines` to limit output. 255 256 --- 257 258 ## Watch & Interactive Selection 259 260 Live HTML preview that auto-refreshes on every file change. Browsers can click / shift-click / box-drag to select shapes; the CLI can read the current browser selection and act on it. 261 262 ```bash 263 officecli watch [--port N] # Start preview server (default port 18080) 264 officecli unwatch # Stop 265 officecli goto # Scroll watching browser(s) to element (docx: p / table / tr / tc) 266 ``` 267 268 Open the printed `http://localhost:N` URL. Click to select; shift/cmd/ctrl+click to multi-select; drag from empty space to box-select. PPT/Word use blue outline; Excel uses native-style green selection (double-click cell to edit inline; drag a chart to reposition). 269 270 ### `get selected` — read what the user clicked 271 272 ```bash 273 officecli get selected [--json] 274 ``` 275 276 Returns DocumentNodes for whatever is currently selected. Empty result if nothing selected. Exit code != 0 if no watch is running. 277 278 ```bash 279 # User clicks shapes in the browser, then asks "make these red" 280 PATHS=$(officecli get deck.pptx selected --json | jq -r '.data.Results[].path') 281 for p in $PATHS; do officecli set deck.pptx "$p" --prop fill=FF0000; done 282 ``` 283 284 ### Key properties 285 286 - **Selection survives file edits.** Paths use stable `@id=` form. 287 - **All connected browsers share one selection.** Last-write-wins. 288 - **Same-file single-watch.** A given file can have only one watch process at a time. 289 - **Group shapes select as a whole.** Drilling into individual children of a group is not supported in v1. 290 - **Coverage:** `.pptx` shapes/pictures/tables/charts/connectors/groups; `.docx` top-level paragraphs and tables. Inherited layout/master decorations and Word nested elements (table cells, run-level) are not addressable. **`.xlsx` does not emit `data-path`** — `mark`/`selection` on xlsx always resolve `stale=true` (v2 candidate). 291 292 ### Marks — edit proposals waiting for review 293 294 Use `mark` when changes need human review BEFORE they hit the file. Marks live in the watch process only; a separate `set` pipeline applies accepted ones. For one-shot changes use `set` directly; for permanent file annotations use `add --type comment` (Word native). 295 296 ```bash 297 officecli mark [--prop find=... color=... note=... tofix=... regex=true] [--json] 298 officecli unmark [--path

| --all] [--json] 299 officecli get-marks [--json] 300 ``` 301 302 Props: `find` (literal or regex when `regex=true`; raw form `find='r"[abc]"'`), `color` (hex / `rgb(...)` / 22 named whitelist), `note`, `tofix` (drives apply pipeline). **Path** must be `data-path` format from watch HTML — see subskills for full pipeline. 303 304 --- 305 306 ## L2: DOM Operations 307 308 ### set — modify properties 309 310 ```bash 311 officecli set --prop key=value [--prop ...] 312 ``` 313 314 **Any XML attribute is settable** via element path (found via `get --depth N`) — even attributes not currently present. Without `find=`, `set` applies format to the entire element. 315 316 **Value formats:** 317 318 | Type | Format | Examples | 319 |------|--------|---------| 320 | Colors | Hex (with/without `#`), named, RGB, theme | `FF0000`, `#FF0000`, `red`, `rgb(255,0,0)`, `accent1`..`accent6` | 321 | Spacing | Unit-qualified | `12pt`, `0.5cm`, `1.5x`, `150%` | 322 | Dimensions | EMU or suffixed | `914400`, `2.54cm`, `1in`, `72pt`, `96px` | 323 324 **Dotted-attr aliases** — `font.` forms accepted on shape/run/paragraph/table/row/cell/section/styles, e.g. `--prop font.color=red --prop font.bold=true --prop font.size=14pt`. Run `officecli help ` for the full list. 325 326 ### find — format or replace matched text 327 328 Use `find=` with `set` to target specific text for formatting or replacement. Format props are separate `--prop` flags — do NOT nest them. 329 330 ```bash 331 # Format matched text (auto-splits runs) 332 officecli set doc.docx '/body/p[1]' --prop find=weather --prop bold=true --prop color=red 333 334 # Regex matching 335 officecli set doc.docx '/body/p[1]' --prop 'find=\d+%' --prop regex=true --prop color=red 336 337 # Replace text (use `/` for whole-document scope) 338 officecli set doc.docx / --prop find=draft --prop replace=final 339 340 # PPT — same syntax, different paths 341 officecli set slides.pptx / --prop find=draft --prop replace=final 342 ``` 343 344 **Path controls search scope:** `/` = whole document, `/body/p[1]` or `/slide[N]/shape[M]` = specific element, `/header[1]` / `/footer[1]` = headers/footers. 345 346 **Notes:** 347 - Case-sensitive by default. Case-insensitive: `--prop 'find=(?i)error' --prop regex=true` 348 - Matches work across run boundaries 349 - No match = silent success. `--json` includes `"matched": N` 350 - **Excel:** only `find` + `replace` supported (no find + format props) 351 352 ### add — add elements or clone 353 354 ```bash 355 officecli add --type [--prop ...] 356 officecli add --type --after [--prop ...] # insert after anchor 357 officecli add --type --before [--prop ...] # insert before anchor 358 officecli add --type --index N [--prop ...] # 0-based position (legacy) 359 officecli add --from # clone existing element 360 ``` 361 362 `--after`, `--before`, `--index` are mutually exclusive. No position flag = append to end. 363 364 **Element types (with aliases):** 365 366 | Format | Types | 367 |--------|-------| 368 | **pptx** | slide (incl. hidden), shape (textbox — font.latin/ea/cs, direction=rtl), picture (SVG, brightness/contrast/glow/shadow), chart (direction=rtl), table (cell direction=rtl), row (tr), connector (connection/line), group, video (audio/media, trim), equation (formula/math), notes (direction=rtl, lang), comment (RTL via U+200F bidi mark; full CRUD via /slide[N]/comment[M]), paragraph (para), run, zoom (slidezoom), ole (oleobject/object/embed), placeholder (phType=title/body/subtitle/footer/...). slideLayout/slideMaster direction inheritance. | 369 | **docx** | paragraph (para — direction/font.latin/ea/cs, bold.cs/italic.cs/size.cs for RTL/CJK; lang.latin/ea/cs BCP-47 tags on run; wordWrap toggle), run, table (direction=rtl → bidiVisual), row (tr), cell (td), image (picture/img — SVG supported), header (direction), footer (direction), section (pageNumFmt full ECMA-376 enum incl. Hindi/Arabic/Thai/CJK numerals; direction=rtl on Add/Set; rtlGutter; pgBorders=box shorthand), bookmark, comment, footnote, endnote, formfield (text/checkbox/dropdown), sdt (contentcontrol), chart, equation, field (28 types incl. mergefield/ref/seq/styleref/docproperty/if), hyperlink, style (direction round-trip), toc, watermark, break (pagebreak/columnbreak), ole, **num / abstractNum / lvl** (numbering/list system), **tab** (paragraph or paragraph/table style tab stops). docDefaults.rtl document-wide override; `get /` exposes `locale`. Document protection: `set / --prop protection=forms\|readOnly\|comments\|trackedChanges\|none` | 370 | **xlsx** | sheet (visible/hidden/veryHidden, print margins, printTitleRows/Cols, rightToLeft sheetView, cascade-aware rename), row, cell (type=richtext+runs, merge=range/sweep, direction=rtl, phonetic guide on add), chart (direction=rtl on per-axis txPr / title; incl. pareto), image (picture — SVG), comment (direction=rtl), table (listobject), namedrange (definedname, volatile, `[@name=X]` selector), pivottable (pivot, calculatedField), sparkline, validation (datavalidation), autofilter, shape, textbox, databar/colorscale/iconset/formulacf/cellIs/topN/aboveAverage (conditional formatting), ole, csv (tsv). Query supports `merge`/`mergedrange` aliases for `mergeCell`. Workbook: password. `value="=SUM(...)"` auto-detects as formula. Chart/picture/shape/slicer accept `anchor=A1:E10`. | 371 372 ### Pivot tables (xlsx) 373 374 ```bash 375 officecli add data.xlsx /Sheet1 --type pivottable \ 376 --prop source="Sheet1!A1:E100" --prop rows=Region,Category \ 377 --prop cols=Year --prop values="Sales:sum,Qty:count" \ 378 --prop grandTotals=rows --prop subtotals=off --prop sort=asc 379 ``` 380 381 Key props: `rows`, `cols`, `values` (Field:func[:showDataAs]), `filters`, `source`, `position`, `layout` (compact/outline/tabular), `repeatLabels`, `blankRows`, `aggregate`, `showDataAs` (percent_of_total/row/col, running_total), `grandTotals`, `subtotals`, `sort`. Aggregators: sum, count, average, max, min, product, stdDev, stdDevp, var, varp, countNums. Date columns auto-group. Run `officecli help xlsx pivottable` for full schema. 382 383 ### Document-level properties (all formats) 384 385 ```bash 386 officecli set doc.docx / --prop docDefaults.font=Arial --prop docDefaults.fontSize=11pt 387 officecli set doc.docx / --prop protection=forms --prop evenAndOddHeaders=true 388 officecli set data.xlsx / --prop calc.mode=manual --prop calc.refMode=r1c1 389 officecli set slides.pptx / --prop defaultFont=Arial --prop show.loop=true --prop print.what=handouts 390 ``` 391 392 Run `officecli help /` for all document-level properties (docDefaults, docGrid, CJK spacing, calc, print, show, theme, extended). 393 394 ### Sort (xlsx) 395 396 ```bash 397 officecli set data.xlsx /Sheet1 --prop sort="C desc" --prop sortHeader=true 398 officecli set data.xlsx '/Sheet1/A1:D100' --prop sort="A asc" --prop sortHeader=true 399 ``` 400 401 Format: `COL DIR[, COL DIR ...]`. Rejects ranges with merged cells or formulas. Sidecar metadata (hyperlinks, comments, conditional formatting, drawings) follows rows automatically. 402 403 ### Text-anchored insert (`--after find:X` / `--before find:X`) 404 405 Locate an insertion point by text match within a paragraph. Inline types (run, picture, hyperlink) insert within the paragraph; block types (table, paragraph) auto-split it. PPT only supports inline. 406 407 ```bash 408 # Word: inline run after matched text 409 officecli add doc.docx '/body/p[1]' --type run --after find:weather --prop text=" (sunny)" 410 411 # Word: block table after matched text (auto-splits paragraph) 412 officecli add doc.docx '/body/p[1]' --type table --after "find:First sentence." --prop rows=2 --prop cols=2 413 ``` 414 415 ### Clone 416 417 `officecli add / --from '/slide[1]'` — copies with all cross-part relationships. 418 419 ### move, swap, remove 420 421 ```bash 422 officecli move [--to ] [--index N] [--after ] [--before ] 423 officecli swap 424 officecli remove '/body/p[4]' 425 ``` 426 427 When using `--after` or `--before`, `--to` can be omitted — the target container is inferred from the anchor. 428 429 ### batch — multiple operations in one save cycle 430 431 Continues on error by default (returns exit 1 if any item fails). Use `--stop-on-error` to abort on the first failure. `--force` is the docx-protection bypass. 432 433 `officecli dump ` emits a replayable batch JSON for full-document round-trip; `officecli refresh ` recalculates TOC page numbers / PAGE / cross-references after replay (Word backend on Windows; headless-HTML fallback elsewhere). 434 435 ```bash 436 echo '[ 437 {"command":"set","path":"/Sheet1/A1","props":{"value":"Name","bold":"true"}}, 438 {"command":"set","path":"/Sheet1/B1","props":{"value":"Score","bold":"true"}} 439 ]' | officecli batch data.xlsx --json 440 441 officecli batch data.xlsx --commands '[{"op":"set","path":"/Sheet1/A1","props":{"value":"Done"}}]' --json 442 officecli batch data.xlsx --input updates.json --force --json 443 ``` 444 445 Supports: `add`, `set`, `get`, `query`, `remove`, `move`, `swap`, `view`, `raw`, `raw-set`, `validate`. Fields: `command` (or `op`), `path`, `parent`, `type`, `from`, `to`, `index`, `after`, `before`, `props`, `selector`, `mode`, `depth`, `part`, `xpath`, `action`, `xml`. 446 447 --- 448 449 ## L3: Raw XML 450 451 Use when L2 cannot express what you need. No xmlns declarations needed — prefixes auto-registered. 452 453 ```bash 454 officecli raw # view raw XML 455 officecli raw-set --xpath "..." --action replace --xml '...' 456 officecli add-part # create new document part (returns rId) 457 ``` 458 459 `raw-set` actions: `append`, `prepend`, `insertbefore`, `insertafter`, `replace`, `remove`, `setattr`. Run `officecli help raw` for available parts. 460 461 --- 462 463 ## Common Pitfalls 464 465 | Pitfall | Correct Approach | 466 |---------|-----------------| 467 | `--name "foo"` | Use `--prop name="foo"` — all attributes go through `--prop` | 468 | Unquoted `[N]` paths in zsh/bash | Always quote: `'/slide[1]'` or `"/slide[1]"` (shell glob-expands brackets) | 469 | PPT `shape[1]` for content | `shape[1]` is typically the title placeholder. Use `shape[2]+` for content shapes | 470 | `/shape[myname]` | Name indexing not supported. Use numeric index or `@name=` (PPT only) | 471 | Guessing property names | Run `officecli help ` to see exact names | 472 | Modifying an open file | Close the file in PowerPoint/WPS first | 473 | `\n` in shell strings | Use `\\n` for newlines in `--prop text="..."` | 474 | `$` in shell text | `--prop text="$15M"` strips `$15`. Use single quotes: `--prop text='$15M'`, or heredoc batch | 475 476 --- 477 478 ## Specialized Skills 479 480 `officecli load_skill ` — output is a SKILL.md, follow its rules. 481 482 **Loading rule**: 483 - Pick the most specific match in "When to use"; if none fits, load the format default (`word` / `pptx` / `excel`). 484 - Scenes already contain the format default's rules — load **one** skill per artifact, never stack. 485 - Loaded rules persist across turns; don't re-load each reply. 486 - Two distinct artifacts → two separate loads. 487 488 ### Word (.docx) 489 490 | Name | When to use | 491 |------|-------------| 492 | `word` | Reports, letters, memos, proposals, generic documents | 493 | `academic-paper` | Journal / conference / thesis: APA / Chicago / IEEE / MLA citations, equations, SEQ + PAGEREF cross-refs, multi-column journal layout, bibliography. NOT for business reports or letters (route those to `word`) | 494 495 ### PowerPoint (.pptx) 496 497 | Name | When to use | 498 |------|-------------| 499 | `pptx` | Generic decks: board reviews, sales decks, all-hands, product launches | 500 | `pitch-deck` | **Fundraising only** — seed / Series A-C / SAFE / convertible / strategic raise. NOT for sales / product / board decks (route those to `pptx`) | 501 | `morph-ppt` | Cinematic Morph-animated presentations. NOT for static decks (route those to `pptx`) | 502 | `morph-ppt-3d` | 3D Morph: GLB models, camera moves, depth. NOT for 2D-only Morph (route those to `morph-ppt`) | 503 504 ### Excel (.xlsx) 505 506 | Name | When to use | 507 |------|-------------| 508 | `excel` | Generic workbooks, formulas, pivots, trackers | 509 | `financial-model` | Financial models, scenarios, projections. NOT for general data analysis (route those to `excel`) | 510 | `data-dashboard` | CSV/tabular data → KPI / analytics / executive dashboards with charts and sparklines. NOT for raw data tracking (route those to `excel`) | 511 512 Example: a fundraising deck task → `officecli load_skill pitch-deck` → use the printed rules. 513 514 --- 515 516 ## Notes 517 518 - Paths are **1-based** (XPath convention): `'/body/p[3]'` = third paragraph 519 - `--index` is **0-based** (array convention): `--index 0` = first position 520 - After modifications, verify with `validate` and/or `view issues` 521 - **When unsure**, run `officecli help ` instead of guessing 522 523 --- 524 525 ## uniEx 专用：DTRB Case 实战用法 526 527 DTRB 评审 PPT（`全J超算中心项目_DTRB 评审2025.12.18.pptx`）包含 6 个嵌入附件： 528 529 ```bash 530 # 1. 查看 PPT 结构 531 officecli view "全J超算中心项目_DTRB 评审2025.12.18.pptx" outline 532 533 # 2. 标准嵌入文件（ppt/embeddings/ 解压后直接用 officecli） 534 officecli view ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Word_Document.docx outline 535 officecli view ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx stats 536 officecli get ppt/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel_Worksheet.xlsx "/Sheet1/A1:F50" --json 537 538 # 3. OLE .bin 需先 olefile 解包，再 officecli 解析内含文件 539 # oleObject1.bin → Outlook MSG (extract-msg 解析) 540 # oleObject2.bin → RAR5 (unrar 解压后 officecli 解析 xlsx) 541 # oleObject3.bin → ZIP (解压后 officecli 解析 xlsx) 542 ``` 543 544 ## uniEx 专用：常见陷阱 545 546 1. **OLE .bin 不是直接可读文件** — 需先用 `olefile` 解析 OLE 复合文档，再从 `Ole10Native` 流提取实际内容 547 2. **华为网络代理** — 公司环境可能需要配置 `no_proxy` 或离线安装（优先从 `reference/` 目录本地安装） 548 3. **大文件性能** — 1000+ 行 Excel 使用 `--json` 输出较慢，建议用 `query` + 范围限定 549 550 ## uniEx 专用：依赖 551 552 ```bash 553 # officecli 本身是单 binary，无外部依赖（见上方 Install 章节） 554 555 # OLE 解析额外依赖（DTRB Case 必需，已包含在 pyproject.toml） 556 # olefile, extract-msg 557 558 # RAR 解压（DTRB Case oleObject2.bin） 559 # Linux: apt install unrar 560 # macOS: brew install unrar 561 # Windows: 下载 unrar.exe 或使用 7-Zip 562 ```

--- name: officecli version: "1.0.94" description: "OfficeCLI — 统一 Office 文档解析与操作 CLI 工具。支持 docx/xlsx/pptx/pdf/doc/eml 等格式的创建、读取、修改，是 pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx/canvas 五个 skill 的合集升级。适用于需要精准定位单元格/段落/幻灯片路径、或跨格式操作的复杂场景，如 DTRB 评审 PPT 内嵌 OLE 附件提取与解析。" license: Apache-2.0 repository: https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/tree/main install: Local binary — see Install section below --- # OfficeCLI Skill **OfficeCLI** 是一个 CLI 工具，提供对 Office 文档（Word/Excel/PPT/PDF/邮件）的统一创建、读取、修改能力。它封装了 python-docx、openpyxl、python-pptx、pdfplumber 等底层库，提供更精准的路径定位和结构化输出。 > 项目地址：[iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/tree/main) > 下载地址：[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases) > 当前版本：v1.0.94 ## PPTX 矢量 SVG 导出 **officecli 自带 SVG 导出（`officecli view svg`）对华为定制主题 PPT 存在配色丢失问题**：华为主题的 `clrScheme` 将 `lt1`(bg1) 设为 `#666666`、`dk2`(bg2) 设为 `#FFFFFF`（与标准主题相反），officecli 误将 scheme:bg1 解析为白色，导致底色和背景高亮丢失。 **解决方案：** 使用 `scripts/pptx2svg.py` 脚本，走 **PPTX → PDF (PowerPoint COM) → SVG (PyMuPDF)** 路径，完整保留底色、背景高亮和每个元素为独立可选中矢量路径。 ```bash uv run python src/skills/officecli/scripts/pptx2svg.py [output_dir] ``` | 平台 | PPTX→PDF | PDF→SVG | 说明 | |---|---|---|---| | **Windows** | PowerPoint COM (pywin32) | PyMuPDF | 完整保真，含华为定制主题 | | **Linux** | LibreOffice headless | PyMuPDF | 已实现，需 `apt install libreoffice` | **平台差异（必须了解）：** | 维度 | Windows (PowerPoint COM) | Linux (LibreOffice headless) | |---|---|---| | **华为主题保真** | ✅ 完整支持 `clrScheme` 定制主题 | ⚠️ 部分主题可能渲染偏差，建议验证 | | **字体替换** | 使用系统已安装字体 | 需安装对应字体（如 `fonts-wqy-microhei` 用于中文） | | **Group icon 补注入** | ✅ 支持 | ✅ 支持（共用同一套 PPTX 提取逻辑） | | **性能** | ~2-5s/页 | ~3-8s/页（受 CPU 影响） | | **依赖** | pywin32（已含） | libreoffice（需单独安装） | **Linux 安装 LibreOffice：** ```bash # Debian/Ubuntu sudo apt install libreoffice fonts-wqy-microhei # RHEL/CentOS/Fedora sudo dnf install libreoffice langpacks-zh_CN # Alpine (Docker) apk add libreoffice ttf-wqy-zenhei ``` 输出产物：单个 `index.html` 文件，6 页矢量 SVG 直接内嵌（每页元素可单独选中，无需额外 SVG 文件）。 **转换要求（必须遵守）：** 1. **文字保留为 `` 元素** — PyMuPDF `get_svg_image(text_as_path=0)`，禁止将文字转成 path 描边（默认 `text_as_path=1` 会导致文字不可选、不可搜索、渲染异常） 2. **字体映射** — PyMuPDF 将系统字体替换为 `Nimbus Sans`，必须替换回 `Microsoft YaHei`（`s.replace("Nimbus Sans", "Microsoft YaHei")`），否则 Windows 浏览器无法渲染英文字符 3. **SVG 内嵌到 HTML** — 所有页面的 SVG 直接嵌入单个 `index.html`，不生成独立的 `.svg` 文件 4. **多页 ID 防冲突** — 多页 SVG 内嵌时，`id` 和 `url(#)` 引用自动加 slide 前缀（`s1_`, `s2_`, ...） 5. **华为主题保真** — 走 COM 导出 PDF 路径，确保定制 `clrScheme`（如 lt1=#666666）的底色和背景高亮正确渲染 依赖：`pywin32`（已含 pyproject.toml）、`pymupdf`（已含 pyproject.toml） ## 与 uniEx 现有 Skills 的关系 OfficeCLI 是 `src/skills/` 下 pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx/canvas 五个 skill 的**合集升级**： | 现有 Skill | OfficeCLI 对应能力 | uniEx 使用场景 | |---|---|---| | `pdf/` | `officecli view text` + `officecli get` | PDF 文本提取、表单解析 | | `docx/` | `officecli view outline` + `officecli get /body/tbl[N]` | Word 标题层级、表格精准提取 | | `pptx/` | `officecli view slides` + 嵌入附件提取 | PPT 幻灯片、OLE 对象解析 | | `xlsx/` | `officecli view stats` + `officecli query /Sheet1/*` | Excel 逐单元格路径定位 | | `canvas/` | `officecli create` | 文档创建（uniEx 暂不使用） | **uniEx 中优先使用 OfficeCLI 的场景：** - DTRB PPT 内嵌 OLE 附件提取与递归解析 - 需要精准路径定位的深度解析（如 `/body/tbl[1]/tr[2]/tc[3]/p[@paraId=xxx]`） - 跨格式嵌入对象识别（OLE → MSG/ZIP/RAR） **保留现有 Skill 的场景：** - openpyxl 直接操作单元格（证据粒度控制更精细） - pdfplumber 表格识别（无需额外安装） - 批量自动化 pipeline（officecli 适合交互式，pipeline 用 Python API 更高效） --- # officecli AI-friendly CLI for .docx, .xlsx, .pptx. Single binary, no dependencies, no Office installation needed. ## Install ### 本地 binary（推荐，华为内网免外网访问） Binary 存放在 `src/skills/officecli/reference/` 目录，按平台区分： | 平台 | 文件 | 安装命令 | |---|---|---| | **Windows x64** | `officecli-win-x64.exe` | `cp src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-win-x64.exe /usr/local/bin/officecli.exe && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/officecli.exe` | | **Linux ARM64** | `officecli-linux-arm64` | `cp src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-linux-arm64 /usr/local/bin/officecli && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/officecli` | Verify: `officecli --version` ### 从 GitHub Releases 下载更新 访问 [iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI Releases](https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases) 下载对应平台的 binary，替换 `reference/` 目录下的文件： | 平台 | Releases 中的文件名 | 替换目标 | |---|---|---| | **Windows x64** | `officecli-win-x64.exe` | `src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-win-x64.exe` | | **Linux ARM64** | `officecli-linux-arm64` | `src/skills/officecli/reference/officecli-linux-arm64` | ```bash # 下载最新 release（需外网访问，替换 为实际版本号） TAG="1.0.94" cd src/skills/officecli/reference # Windows x64 curl -fSL -o officecli-win-x64.exe "https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases/download/${TAG}/officecli-win-x64.exe" # Linux ARM64 curl -fSL -o officecli-linux-arm64 "https://github.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/releases/download/${TAG}/officecli-linux-arm64" chmod +x officecli-linux-arm64 ``` 下载替换后重新执行上面的本地安装命令即可。更新版本后需同步修改本文件 frontmatter 的 `version` 字段。 --- ## Strategy **L1 (read) → L2 (DOM edit) → L3 (raw XML)**. Always prefer higher layers. Add `--json` for structured output. **Before doc work, check Specialized Skills** (bottom of this file). Fundraising decks, academic papers, financial models, dashboards, and Morph animations need their own skill loaded first — `load_skill` once, then proceed. --- ## Help System (IMPORTANT) **When unsure about property names, value formats, or command syntax, ALWAYS run help instead of guessing.** One help query beats guess-fail-retry loops. `officecli help` ≡ `officecli --help`, and `officecli --help` ≡ `officecli help ` — same content. ```bash officecli help # All commands + global options + schema entry points officecli help docx # List all docx elements officecli help docx paragraph # Full schema: properties, aliases, examples, readbacks officecli help docx set paragraph # Verb-filtered: only props usable with `set` officecli help docx paragraph --json # Structured schema (machine-readable) ``` Format aliases: `word`→`docx`, `excel`→`xlsx`, `ppt`/`powerpoint`→`pptx`. Verbs: `add`, `set`, `get`, `query`, `remove`. MCP exposes the same schema via `{"command":"help","format":"docx","type":"paragraph"}`. --- ## Performance: Resident Mode **Every command auto-starts a resident on first access** (60s idle timeout) — file-lock conflicts are automatically avoided. Explicit `open`/`close` is still recommended for longer sessions (12min idle): ```bash officecli open report.docx # explicitly keep in memory officecli set report.docx ... # no file I/O overhead officecli close report.docx # save and release ``` Opt out of auto-start: `OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_RESIDENT=1`. --- ## Quick Start **PPT:** ```bash officecli create slides.pptx officecli add slides.pptx / --type slide --prop title="Q4 Report" --prop background=1A1A2E officecli add slides.pptx '/slide[1]' --type shape --prop text="Revenue grew 25%" --prop x=2cm --prop y=5cm --prop font=Arial --prop size=24 --prop color=FFFFFF ``` **Word:** ```bash officecli create report.docx officecli add report.docx /body --type paragraph --prop text="Executive Summary" --prop style=Heading1 officecli add report.docx /body --type paragraph --prop text="Revenue increased by 25% year-over-year." ``` **Excel:** ```bash officecli create data.xlsx officecli set data.xlsx /Sheet1/A1 --prop value="Name" --prop bold=true officecli set data.xlsx /Sheet1/A2 --prop value="Alice" ``` --- ## L1: Create, Read & Inspect ```bash officecli create # Create blank .docx/.xlsx/.pptx (type from extension) officecli view # outline | stats | issues | text | annotated | html officecli get --depth N # Get a node and its children [--json] officecli query # CSS-like query officecli validate # Validate against OpenXML schema ``` ### view modes | Mode | Description | Useful flags | |------|-------------|-------------| | `outline` | Document structure | | | `stats` | Statistics (pages, words, shapes) | | | `issues` | Formatting/content/structure problems | `--type format\|content\|structure`, `--limit N` | | `text` | Plain text extraction | `--start N --end N`, `--max-lines N` | | `annotated` | Text with formatting annotations | | | `html` | Static HTML snapshot — same renderer as `watch`, no server needed | `--browser`, `--page N` (docx), `--start N --end N` (pptx) | Use `view html` for one-shot snapshots (CI artifacts, archival, diffing); use `watch` when you need live refresh or browser-side click-to-select. ### get Any XML path via element localName. Use `--depth N` to expand children. Add `--json` for structured output. Default text output is grep-friendly: `path (type) "text" key=val key=val ...` ```bash officecli get report.docx '/body/p[3]' --depth 2 --json officecli get slides.pptx '/slide[1]' --depth 1 # list all shapes on slide 1 officecli get data.xlsx '/Sheet1/B2' --json ``` ### Stable ID Addressing Elements with stable IDs return `@attr=value` paths instead of positional indices. Prefer these in multi-step workflows — positional indices shift on insert/delete, stable IDs do not. ``` /slide[1]/shape[@id=550950021] # PPT shape /slide[1]/table[@id=1388430425]/tr[1]/tc[2] # PPT table /body/p[@paraId=1A2B3C4D] # Word paragraph /comments/comment[@commentId=1] # Word comment ``` PPT also accepts `@name=` (e.g. `shape[@name=Title 1]`), with morph `!!` prefix awareness. Elements without stable IDs (slide, run, tr/tc, row) fall back to positional indices. ### query CSS-like selectors: `[attr=value]`, `[attr!=value]`, `[attr~=text]`, `[attr>=value]`, `[attr<=value]`, `:contains("text")`, `:empty`, `:has(formula)`, `:no-alt`. ```bash officecli query report.docx 'paragraph[style=Normal] > run[font!=Arial]' officecli query slides.pptx 'shape[fill=FF0000]' ``` For large documents, use `--max-lines` to limit output. --- ## Watch & Interactive Selection Live HTML preview that auto-refreshes on every file change. Browsers can click / shift-click / box-drag to select shapes; the CLI can read the current browser selection and act on it. ```bash officecli watch [--port N] # Start preview server (default port 18080) officecli unwatch # Stop officecli goto # Scroll watching browser(s) to element (docx: p / table / tr / tc) ``` Open the printed `http://localhost:N` URL. Click to select; shift/cmd/ctrl+click to multi-select; drag from empty space to box-select. PPT/Word use blue outline; Excel uses native-style green selection (double-click cell to edit inline; drag a chart to reposition). ### `get selected` — read what the user clicked ```bash officecli get selected [--json] ``` Returns DocumentNodes for whatever is currently selected. Empty result if nothing selected. Exit code != 0 if no watch is running. ```bash # User clicks shapes in the browser, then asks "make these red" PATHS=$(officecli get deck.pptx selected --json | jq -r '.data.Results[].path') for p in $PATHS; do officecli set deck.pptx "$p" --prop fill=FF0000; done ``` ### Key properties - **Selection survives file edits.** Paths use stable `@id=` form. - **All connected browsers share one selection.** Last-write-wins. - **Same-file single-watch.** A given file can have only one watch process at a time. - **Group shapes select as a whole.** Drilling into individual children of a group is not supported in v1. - **Coverage:** `.pptx` shapes/pictures/tables/charts/connectors/groups; `.docx` top-level paragraphs and tables. Inherited layout/master decorations and Word nested elements (table cells, run-level) are not addressable. **`.xlsx` does not emit `data-path`** — `mark`/`selection` on xlsx always resolve `stale=true` (v2 candidate). ### Marks — edit proposals waiting for review Use `mark` when changes need human review BEFORE they hit the file. Marks live in the watch process only; a separate `set` pipeline applies accepted ones. For one-shot changes use `set` directly; for permanent file annotations use `add --type comment` (Word native). ```bash officecli mark [--prop find=... color=... note=... tofix=... regex=true] [--json] officecli unmark [--path

| --all] [--json] officecli get-marks [--json] ``` Props: `find` (literal or regex when `regex=true`; raw form `find='r"[abc]"'`), `color` (hex / `rgb(...)` / 22 named whitelist), `note`, `tofix` (drives apply pipeline). **Path** must be `data-path` format from watch HTML — see subskills for full pipeline. --- ## L2: DOM Operations ### set — modify properties ```bash officecli set --prop key=value [--prop ...] ``` **Any XML attribute is settable** via element path (found via `get --depth N`) — even attributes not currently present. Without `find=`, `set` applies format to the entire element. **Value formats:** | Type | Format | Examples | |------|--------|---------| | Colors | Hex (with/without `#`), named, RGB, theme | `FF0000`, `#FF0000`, `red`, `rgb(255,0,0)`, `accent1`..`accent6` | | Spacing | Unit-qualified | `12pt`, `0.5cm`, `1.5x`, `150%` | | Dimensions | EMU or suffixed | `914400`, `2.54cm`, `1in`, `72pt`, `96px` | **Dotted-attr aliases** — `font.` forms accepted on shape/run/paragraph/table/row/cell/section/styles, e.g. `--prop font.color=red --prop font.bold=true --prop font.size=14pt`. Run `officecli help ` for the full list. ### find — format or replace matched text Use `find=` with `set` to target specific text for formatting or replacement. Format props are separate `--prop` flags — do NOT nest them. ```bash # Format matched text (auto-splits runs) officecli set doc.docx '/body/p[1]' --prop find=weather --prop bold=true --prop color=red # Regex matching officecli set doc.docx '/body/p[1]' --prop 'find=\d+%' --prop regex=true --prop color=red # Replace text (use `/` for whole-document scope) officecli set doc.docx / --prop find=draft --prop replace=final # PPT — same syntax, different paths officecli set slides.pptx / --prop find=draft --prop replace=final ``` **Path controls search scope:** `/` = whole document, `/body/p[1]` or `/slide[N]/shape[M]` = specific element, `/header[1]` / `/footer[1]` = headers/footers. **Notes:** - Case-sensitive by default. Case-insensitive: `--prop 'find=(?i)error' --prop regex=true` - Matches work across run boundaries - No match = silent success. `--json` includes `"matched": N` - **Excel:** only `find` + `replace` supported (no find + format props) ### add — add elements or clone ```bash officecli add --type [--prop ...] officecli add --type --after [--prop ...] # insert after anchor officecli add --type --before [--prop ...] # insert before anchor officecli add --type --index N [--prop ...] # 0-based position (legacy) officecli add --from # clone existing element ``` `--after`, `--before`, `--index` are mutually exclusive. No position flag = append to end. **Element types (with aliases):** | Format | Types | |--------|-------| | **pptx** | slide (incl. hidden), shape (textbox — font.latin/ea/cs, direction=rtl), picture (SVG, brightness/contrast/glow/shadow), chart (direction=rtl), table (cell direction=rtl), row (tr), connector (connection/line), group, video (audio/media, trim), equation (formula/math), notes (direction=rtl, lang), comment (RTL via U+200F bidi mark; full CRUD via /slide[N]/comment[M]), paragraph (para), run, zoom (slidezoom), ole (oleobject/object/embed), placeholder (phType=title/body/subtitle/footer/...). slideLayout/slideMaster direction inheritance. | | **docx** | paragraph (para — direction/font.latin/ea/cs, bold.cs/italic.cs/size.cs for RTL/CJK; lang.latin/ea/cs BCP-47 tags on run; wordWrap toggle), run, table (direction=rtl → bidiVisual), row (tr), cell (td), image (picture/img — SVG supported), header (direction), footer (direction), section (pageNumFmt full ECMA-376 enum incl. Hindi/Arabic/Thai/CJK numerals; direction=rtl on Add/Set; rtlGutter; pgBorders=box shorthand), bookmark, comment, footnote, endnote, formfield (text/checkbox/dropdown), sdt (contentcontrol), chart, equation, field (28 types incl. mergefield/ref/seq/styleref/docproperty/if), hyperlink, style (direction round-trip), toc, watermark, break (pagebreak/columnbreak), ole, **num / abstractNum / lvl** (numbering/list system), **tab** (paragraph or paragraph/table style tab stops). docDefaults.rtl document-wide override; `get /` exposes `locale`. Document protection: `set / --prop protection=forms\|readOnly\|comments\|trackedChanges\|none` | | **xlsx** | sheet (visible/hidden/veryHidden, print margins, printTitleRows/Cols, rightToLeft sheetView, cascade-aware rename), row, cell (type=richtext+runs, merge=range/sweep, direction=rtl, phonetic guide on add), chart (direction=rtl on per-axis txPr / title; incl. pareto), image (picture — SVG), comment (direction=rtl), table (listobject), namedrange (definedname, volatile, `[@name=X]` selector), pivottable (pivot, calculatedField), sparkline, validation (datavalidation), autofilter, shape, textbox, databar/colorscale/iconset/formulacf/cellIs/topN/aboveAverage (conditional formatting), ole, csv (tsv). Query supports `merge`/`mergedrange` aliases for `mergeCell`. Workbook: password. `value="=SUM(...)"` auto-detects as formula. Chart/picture/shape/slicer accept `anchor=A1:E10`. | ### Pivot tables (xlsx) ```bash officecli add data.xlsx /Sheet1 --type pivottable \ --prop source="Sheet1!A1:E100" --prop rows=Region,Category \ --prop cols=Year --prop values="Sales:sum,Qty:count" \ --prop grandTotals=rows --prop subtotals=off --prop sort=asc ``` Key props: `rows`, `cols`, `values` (Field:func[:showDataAs]), `filters`, `source`, `position`, `layout` (compact/outline/tabular), `repeatLabels`, `blankRows`, `aggregate`, `showDataAs` (percent_of_total/row/col, running_total), `grandTotals`, `subtotals`, `sort`. Aggregators: sum, count, average, max, min, product, stdDev, stdDevp, var, varp, countNums. Date columns auto-group. """
Demo: 交叉引用 — officecli SVG → svg2pptx 可编辑 PPTX。

链路：hw_template.pptx  →  officecli (COM+PyMuPDF)  →  .svg  →  svg2pptx  →  .pptx

用法:
    # Step 1: 用 officecli 导出 SVG
    uv run python src/skills/officecli/scripts/pptx2svg.py hw_template.pptx out/ --export-svg --max-slides 3

    # Step 2: 用 svg2pptx 转换回可编辑 PPTX
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg-dir out/svg

    # 单页
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg out/svg/slide3.svg -o demo.pptx
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

_script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if sys.path[0] == _script_dir:
    sys.path.pop(0)

from lxml import etree
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Emu
from svg2pptx import SVGConverter

SLIDE_W = 12192000
SLIDE_H = 6858000

NS_SVG = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"


def _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path: str) -> str:
    """Preprocess PyMuPDF-generated SVG so svg2pptx can read text positions.

    PyMuPDF generates <text> without x/y, placing them only on <tspan> children,
    and using negative Y values (y-flip coordinate system).
    svg2pptx reads only <text x="..." y="..."> and cannot position text otherwise.

    This writes a normalized copy to a temp file and returns its path.
    """
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    svg_h = 540.0
    vb = root.get("viewBox", "")
    if vb:
        parts = vb.split()
        if len(parts) == 4:
            try:
                svg_h = float(parts[3])
            except ValueError:
                pass

    for text_el in root.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}text"):
        # Skip if <text> already has x/y
        if text_el.get("x") and text_el.get("y"):
            continue

        # Gather tspan positions to compute a bounding-box position
        first_x = None
        first_y = None
        for tspan in text_el.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}tspan"):
            xs = tspan.get("x", "")
            ys = tspan.get("y", "")
            if xs and ys:
                try:
                    x_vals = [float(v) for v in xs.split()]
                    y_val = float(ys.split()[0])
                    if first_x is None:
                        first_x = x_vals[0]
                    if first_y is None:
                        first_y = y_val
                except ValueError:
                    continue

        if first_x is not None and first_y is not None:
            # Fix negative y (PyMuPDF y-flip): display_y = svg_h + y
            if first_y < 0:
                first_y = svg_h + first_y
            text_el.set("x", str(first_x))
            text_el.set("y", str(first_y))

    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".svg", delete=False)
    tree.write(tmp.name, encoding="unicode", xml_declaration=True)
    tmp.close()
    return tmp.name


def svg_to_pptx(svg_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
    try:
        prs = Presentation()
        prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
        prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

        converter = SVGConverter()
        converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)

        prs.save(output_path)
    finally:
        os.unlink(normalized)

    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name} -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_paths: list[str], output_path: str) -> None:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

    for svg_path in svg_paths:
        normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
        try:
            slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
            converter = SVGConverter()
            converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)
        finally:
            os.unlink(normalized)
        print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name}")

    prs.save(output_path)
    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="officecli SVG → svg2pptx → editable PPTX (cross-reference demo)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--svg", help="单个 SVG 文件路径")
    parser.add_argument("--svg-dir", help="SVG 目录路径 (合并所有 .svg)")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="demo_svg2pptx_output.pptx")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.svg_dir:
        svg_dir = Path(args.svg_dir)
        svg_files = sorted(
            str(f) for f in svg_dir.glob("slide[0-9]*.svg")
            if not f.name.endswith("_normalized.svg") and not f.name.endswith("_norm_v2.svg")
        )
        if not svg_files:
            print(f"错误: 目录下无 SVG: {svg_dir}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"officecli SVG -> svg2pptx ({len(svg_files)} pages)")
        svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_files, args.output)
    elif args.svg:
        svg_path = Path(args.svg)
        if not svg_path.exists():
            print(f"错误: 文件不存在: {svg_path}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"officecli SVG -> svg2pptx (single)")
        svg_to_pptx(str(svg_path), args.output)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        raise SystemExit(1)

    print(f"\n打开验证: start {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Demo: 交叉引用 — officecli SVG → svg2pptx 可编辑 PPTX。

链路：hw_template.pptx  →  officecli (COM+PyMuPDF)  →  .svg  →  svg2pptx  →  .pptx

用法:
    # Step 1: 用 officecli 导出 SVG
    uv run python src/skills/officecli/scripts/pptx2svg.py hw_template.pptx out/ --export-svg --max-slides 3

    # Step 2: 用 svg2pptx 转换回可编辑 PPTX
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg-dir out/svg

    # 单页
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg out/svg/slide3.svg -o demo.pptx
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

_script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if sys.path[0] == _script_dir:
    sys.path.pop(0)

from lxml import etree
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Emu
from svg2pptx import SVGConverter

SLIDE_W = 12192000
SLIDE_H = 6858000


def _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path: str) -> str:
    """Preprocess PyMuPDF-generated SVG so svg2pptx can read text positions.

    PyMuPDF generates <text> without x/y, placing them only on <tspan> children,
    and using negative Y values (y-flip coordinate system).
    svg2pptx reads only <text x="..." y="..."> and cannot position text otherwise.
    """
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    # Detect SVG height for y-flip correction
    svg_h = 540.0
    vb = root.get("viewBox", "")
    if vb:
        parts = vb.split()
        if len(parts) == 4:
            try:
                svg_h = float(parts[3])
            except ValueError:
                pass

    for text_el in root.iter(f"{{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}}text"):
        if text_el.get("x") and text_el.get("y"):
            continue

        first_x = None
        first_y = None
        for tspan in text_el.iter(f"{{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}}tspan"):
            xs = tspan.get("x", "")
            ys = tspan.get("y", "")
            if xs and ys:
                try:
                    x_vals = [float(v) for v in xs.split()]
                    y_val = float(ys.split()[0])
                    if first_x is None:
                        first_x = x_vals[0]
                    if first_y is None:
                        first_y = y_val
                except ValueError:
                    continue

        if first_x is not None and first_y is not None:
            if first_y < 0:
                first_y = svg_h + first_y
            text_el.set("x", str(first_x))
            text_el.set("y", str(first_y))

    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".svg", delete=False)
    tree.write(tmp.name, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    tmp.close()
    return tmp.name


def _remove_foreign_objects(svg_path: str) -> str:
    """Remove <foreignObject> elements from SVG (svg2pptx cannot parse them).

    OfficeCLI SVG uses <foreignObject> + HTML for text rendering.
    svg2pptx only handles standard SVG elements.
    """
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    removed = 0
    for fo in root.iter(f"{{{ns}}}foreignObject"):
        parent = fo.getparent()
        if parent is not None:
            parent.remove(fo)
            removed += 1

    if removed > 0:
        print(f"      Preprocess: removed {removed} foreignObject elements (unsupported by svg2pptx)")

    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".svg", delete=False)
    tree.write(tmp.name, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    tmp.close()
    return tmp.name


def svg_to_pptx(svg_path: str, output_path: str, source: str = "pymupdf") -> None:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

    if source == "pymupdf":
        normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
    else:
        normalized = _remove_foreign_objects(svg_path)

    try:
        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
        converter = SVGConverter()
        converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)
    finally:
        os.unlink(normalized)

    prs.save(output_path)
    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name} -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_paths: list[str], output_path: str, source: str = "pymupdf") -> None:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

    for svg_path in svg_paths:
        if source == "pymupdf":
            normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
        else:
            normalized = _remove_foreign_objects(svg_path)

        try:
            slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
            converter = SVGConverter()
            converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)
        finally:
            os.unlink(normalized)
        print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name}")

    prs.save(output_path)
    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="officecli SVG -> svg2pptx -> editable PPTX (cross-reference demo)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--svg", help="单个 SVG 文件路径")
    parser.add_argument("--svg-dir", help="SVG 目录路径 (合并所有 .svg)")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="demo_svg2pptx_output.pptx")
    parser.add_argument("--source", default="pymupdf", choices=["pymupdf", "officecli"],
                        help="SVG 来源 (default: pymupdf)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.svg_dir:
        svg_dir = Path(args.svg_dir)
        svg_files = sorted(
            str(f) for f in svg_dir.glob("slide[0-9]*.svg")
            if not f.name.endswith("_normalized.svg") and not f.name.endswith("_norm_v2.svg")
        )
        if not svg_files:
            print(f"错误: 目录下无 SVG: {svg_dir}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"SVG -> PPTX ({len(svg_files)} pages, {args.source})")
        svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_files, args.output, args.source)
    elif args.svg:
        svg_path = Path(args.svg)
        if not svg_path.exists():
            print(f"错误: 文件不存在: {svg_path}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"SVG -> PPTX (single, {args.source})")
        svg_to_pptx(str(svg_path), args.output, args.source)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        raise SystemExit(1)

    print(f"\n打开验证: start {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
Demo: 交叉引用 — officecli SVG → svg2pptx 可编辑 PPTX。

链路：hw_template.pptx  →  officecli (COM+PyMuPDF)  →  .svg  →  svg2pptx  →  .pptx

用法:
    # Step 1: 用 officecli 导出 SVG
    uv run python src/skills/officecli/scripts/pptx2svg.py hw_template.pptx out/ --export-svg --max-slides 3

    # Step 2: 用 svg2pptx 转换回可编辑 PPTX
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg-dir out/svg

    # 单页
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg out/svg/slide3.svg -o demo.pptx
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

_script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if sys.path[0] == _script_dir:
    sys.path.pop(0)

from lxml import etree
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Emu
from svg2pptx import SVGConverter

SLIDE_W = 12192000
SLIDE_H = 6858000

NS_SVG = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"


def _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path: str) -> str:
    """Preprocess PyMuPDF-generated SVG so svg2pptx can read text positions.

    PyMuPDF generates <text> without x/y, placing them only on <tspan> children,
    and using negative Y values (y-flip coordinate system).
    svg2pptx reads only <text x="..." y="..."> and cannot position text otherwise.

    This writes a normalized copy to a temp file and returns its path.
    """
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    svg_h = 540.0
    vb = root.get("viewBox", "")
    if vb:
        parts = vb.split()
        if len(parts) == 4:
            try:
                svg_h = float(parts[3])
            except ValueError:
                pass

    for text_el in root.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}text"):
        # Skip if <text> already has x/y
        if text_el.get("x") and text_el.get("y"):
            continue

        # Gather tspan positions to compute a bounding-box position
        first_x = None
        first_y = None
        for tspan in text_el.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}tspan"):
            xs = tspan.get("x", "")
            ys = tspan.get("y", "")
            if xs and ys:
                try:
                    x_vals = [float(v) for v in xs.split()]
                    y_val = float(ys.split()[0])
                    if first_x is None:
                        first_x = x_vals[0]
                    if first_y is None:
                        first_y = y_val
                except ValueError:
                    continue

        if first_x is not None and first_y is not None:
            # Fix negative y (PyMuPDF y-flip): display_y = svg_h + y
            if first_y < 0:
                first_y = svg_h + first_y
            text_el.set("x", str(first_x))
            text_el.set("y", str(first_y))

    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".svg", delete=False)
    tree.write(tmp.name, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    tmp.close()
    return tmp.name


def svg_to_pptx(svg_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
    try:
        prs = Presentation()
        prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
        prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])

        converter = SVGConverter()
        converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)

        prs.save(output_path)
    finally:
        os.unlink(normalized)

    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name} -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_paths: list[str], output_path: str) -> None:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

    for svg_path in svg_paths:
        normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
        try:
            slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
            converter = SVGConverter()
            converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)

    prs.save(output_path)
    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="officecli SVG → svg2pptx → editable PPTX (cross-reference demo)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--svg", help="单个 SVG 文件路径")
    parser.add_argument("--svg-dir", help="SVG 目录路径 (合并所有 .svg)")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="demo_svg2pptx_output.pptx")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.svg_dir:
        svg_dir = Path(args.svg_dir)
        svg_files = sorted(
            str(f) for f in svg_dir.glob("slide[0-9]*.svg")
            if not f.name.endswith("_normalized.svg") and not f.name.endswith("_norm_v2.svg")
        )
        if not svg_files:
            print(f"错误: 目录下无 SVG: {svg_dir}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"officecli SVG -> svg2pptx ({len(svg_files)} pages)")
        svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_files, args.output)
    elif args.svg:
        svg_path = Path(args.svg)
        if not svg_path.exists():
            print(f"错误: 文件不存在: {svg_path}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"officecli SVG -> svg2pptx (single)")
        svg_to_pptx(str(svg_path), args.output)
    else:

        raise SystemExit(1)

    print(f"\n打开验证: start {args.output}")

"""
将 officecli 生成的 SVG 标准化为通用 SVG，供 svg2pptx 等工具消费。

officecli 的 SVG 用 <foreignObject> + HTML 渲染文字，标准 SVG 工具无法识别。
本脚本解析 foreignObject 内的 HTML，提取文字与样式，转换为标准 <text> 元素。

用法:
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/normalize_officecli_svg.py input.svg -o output.svg
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/normalize_officecli_svg.py svg-dir/ -o normalized-dir/
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from lxml import etree

NS_SVG = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
NS_XHTML = "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"


def _parse_translate(transform: str) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
    """Parse translate(x, y) or translate(x) from transform attribute."""
    m = re.match(r"translate\(([^)]+)\)", transform.strip())
    if not m:
        return None
    parts = [float(v.strip()) for v in m.group(1).split(",")]
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return (parts[0], 0.0)
    return (parts[0], parts[1])


def _parse_span(span_el) -> dict | None:
    """Extract text and style from an HTML <span> element."""
    text = (span_el.text or "").strip()
    # Recursively get tail text from children
    for child in span_el:
        if child.tail:
            text += child.tail.strip()
    if not text or text == " ":
        return None

    style_attr = span_el.get("style", "")
    family = "Microsoft YaHei"
    fm = re.search(r"font-family:\s*'([^']+)'", style_attr)
    if fm:
        families = fm.group(1).split(",")
        family = families[0].strip().strip("'\"")
        if family in ("Calibri", "Arial"):
            family = "Microsoft YaHei"

    size_pt = 12.0
    sm = re.search(r"font-size:\s*([\d.]+)\s*pt", style_attr)
    if sm:
        size_pt = float(sm.group(1))

    color = "000000"
    cm = re.search(r"color:\s*(#[A-Fa-f0-9]{6})", style_attr)
    if cm:
        color = cm.group(1).lstrip("#").upper()

    bold = "font-weight:\s*bold" in style_attr or "font-weight:700" in style_attr

    return {"text": text, "family": family, "size_pt": size_pt, "color": color, "bold": bold}


def _extract_textboxes(root) -> list[dict]:
    """Extract textbox info from foreignObject elements, accounting for g transforms.

    Returns list of {x, y, w, h, text, family, size_pt, color, bold}
    with all coordinates in absolute SVG space.
    """
    results = []

    for fo in root.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}foreignObject"):
        # Find the nearest <g> ancestor with a translate transform
        g = fo.getparent()
        acc_tx, acc_ty = 0.0, 0.0
        while g is not None:
            t = g.get("transform", "")
            parsed = _parse_translate(t)
            if parsed:
                acc_tx += parsed[0]
                acc_ty += parsed[1]
            g = g.getparent()

        fo_x = float(fo.get("x", "0"))
        fo_y = float(fo.get("y", "0"))
        fo_w = float(fo.get("width", "100"))
        fo_h = float(fo.get("height", "20"))

        # Extract spans from the HTML inside foreignObject
        for div in fo.iter(f"{{{NS_XHTML}}}div"):
            for span in div.iter(f"{{{NS_XHTML}}}span"):
                info = _parse_span(span)
                if info is None:
                    continue
                info["x"] = acc_tx + fo_x
                info["y"] = acc_ty + fo_y
                info["w"] = fo_w
                info["h"] = fo_h
                results.append(info)

    return results


def normalize(svg_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    svg_h = 1080.0
    vb = root.get("viewBox", "")
    if vb:
        parts = vb.split()
        if len(parts) == 4:
            try:
                svg_h = float(parts[3])
            except ValueError:
                pass

    textboxes = _extract_textboxes(root)
    if not textboxes:
        print(f"  No text found in foreignObject, copying as-is")

    # Remove all foreignObject elements
    removed = 0
    for fo in root.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}foreignObject"):
        parent = fo.getparent()
        if parent is not None:
            parent.remove(fo)
            removed += 1

    # Create <text> elements for each extracted textbox, appended to root
    for tb in textboxes:
        text_el = etree.SubElement(root, f"{{{NS_SVG}}}text")
        text_el.set("x", f"{tb['x']:.2f}")
        text_el.set("y", f"{tb['y'] + tb['size_pt']:.2f}")  # baseline = top + fontSize
        text_el.set("font-size", f"{tb['size_pt']:.1f}")
        text_el.set("font-family", tb["family"])
        text_el.set("fill", f"#{tb['color']}")
        if tb["bold"]:
            text_el.set("font-weight", "bold")
        text_el.text = tb["text"]

    tree.write(output_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    print(f"  {removed} foreignObject -> {len(textboxes)} <text> elements")
    print(f"  Output: {output_path}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Normalize officecli SVG (foreignObject -> <text>) for svg2pptx"
    )
    parser.add_argument("input", help="Input SVG file or directory")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", required=True, help="Output SVG file or directory")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_path = Path(args.input)
    output_path = Path(args.output)

    if input_path.is_dir():
        output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        svg_files = sorted(input_path.glob("*.svg"))
        if not svg_files:
            print(f"Error: No SVG files in {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        print(f"Normalizing {len(svg_files)} SVGs (officecli -> standard)")
        for svg_file in svg_files:
            out_file = output_path / svg_file.name

"""
将 officecli 生成的 SVG 标准化为通用 SVG，供 svg2pptx 等工具消费。

officecli 的 SVG 用 <foreignObject> + HTML 渲染文字，标准 SVG 工具无法识别。
本脚本解析 foreignObject 内的 HTML，提取文字与样式，转换为标准 <text> 元素。

用法:
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/normalize_officecli_svg.py input.svg -o output.svg
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/normalize_officecli_svg.py svg-dir/ -o normalized-dir/
"""

import argparse
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from lxml import etree

NS_SVG = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
NS_XHTML = "http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"


def _parse_translate(transform: str) -> tuple[float, float] | None:
    """Parse translate(x, y) or translate(x) from transform attribute."""
    m = re.match(r"translate\(([^)]+)\)", transform.strip())
    if not m:
        return None
    parts = [float(v.strip()) for v in m.group(1).split(",")]
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return (parts[0], 0.0)
    return (parts[0], parts[1])


def _parse_span(span_el) -> dict | None:
    """Extract text and style from an HTML <span> element."""
    text = (span_el.text or "").strip()
    # Recursively get tail text from children
    for child in span_el:
        if child.tail:
            text += child.tail.strip()
    if not text or text == " ":
        return None

    style_attr = span_el.get("style", "")
    family = "Microsoft YaHei"
    fm = re.search(r"font-family:\s*'([^']+)'", style_attr)
    if fm:
        families = fm.group(1).split(",")
        family = families[0].strip().strip("'\"")
        if family in ("Calibri", "Arial"):
            family = "Microsoft YaHei"

    size_pt = 12.0
    sm = re.search(r"font-size:\s*([\d.]+)\s*pt", style_attr)
    if sm:
        size_pt = float(sm.group(1))

    color = "000000"
    cm = re.search(r"color:\s*(#[A-Fa-f0-9]{6})", style_attr)
    if cm:
        color = cm.group(1).lstrip("#").upper()

    bold = "font-weight:bold" in style_attr.replace(" ", "") or "font-weight:700" in style_attr.replace(" ", "")

    return {"text": text, "family": family, "size_pt": size_pt, "color": color, "bold": bold}


def _extract_textboxes(root) -> list[dict]:
    """Extract textbox info from foreignObject elements, accounting for g transforms.

    Returns list of {x, y, w, h, text, family, size_pt, color, bold}
    with all coordinates in absolute SVG space.
    """
    results = []

    for fo in root.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}foreignObject"):
        # Find the nearest <g> ancestor with a translate transform
        g = fo.getparent()
        acc_tx, acc_ty = 0.0, 0.0
        while g is not None:
            t = g.get("transform", "")
            parsed = _parse_translate(t)
            if parsed:
                acc_tx += parsed[0]
                acc_ty += parsed[1]
            g = g.getparent()

        fo_x = float(fo.get("x", "0"))
        fo_y = float(fo.get("y", "0"))
        fo_w = float(fo.get("width", "100"))
        fo_h = float(fo.get("height", "20"))

        # Extract spans from the HTML inside foreignObject
        for div in fo.iter(f"{{{NS_XHTML}}}div"):
            for span in div.iter(f"{{{NS_XHTML}}}span"):
                info = _parse_span(span)
                if info is None:
                    continue
                info["x"] = acc_tx + fo_x
                info["y"] = acc_ty + fo_y
                info["w"] = fo_w
                info["h"] = fo_h
                results.append(info)

    return results


def normalize(svg_path: str, output_path: str) -> None:
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    svg_h = 1080.0
    vb = root.get("viewBox", "")
    if vb:
        parts = vb.split()
        if len(parts) == 4:
            try:
                svg_h = float(parts[3])
            except ValueError:
                pass

    textboxes = _extract_textboxes(root)
    if not textboxes:
        print(f"  No text found in foreignObject, copying as-is")

    # Remove all foreignObject elements
    removed = 0
    for fo in root.iter(f"{{{NS_SVG}}}foreignObject"):
        parent = fo.getparent()
        if parent is not None:
            parent.remove(fo)
            removed += 1

    # Create <text> elements for each extracted textbox, appended to root
    for tb in textboxes:
        text_el = etree.SubElement(root, f"{{{NS_SVG}}}text")
        text_el.set("x", f"{tb['x']:.2f}")
        text_el.set("y", f"{tb['y'] + tb['size_pt']:.2f}")  # baseline = top + fontSize
        text_el.set("font-size", f"{tb['size_pt']:.1f}")
        text_el.set("font-family", tb["family"])
        text_el.set("fill", f"#{tb['color']}")
        if tb["bold"]:
            text_el.set("font-weight", "bold")
        text_el.text = tb["text"]

    tree.write(output_path, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    print(f"  {removed} foreignObject -> {len(textboxes)} <text> elements")
    print(f"  Output: {output_path}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Normalize officecli SVG (foreignObject -> <text>) for svg2pptx"
    )
    parser.add_argument("input", help="Input SVG file or directory")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", required=True, help="Output SVG file or directory")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    input_path = Path(args.input)
    output_path = Path(args.output)

    if input_path.is_dir():
        output_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        svg_files = sorted(input_path.glob("*.svg"))
        if not svg_files:
            print(f"Error: No SVG files in {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        print(f"Normalizing {len(svg_files)} SVGs (officecli -> standard)")
        for svg_file in svg_files:
            out_file = output_path / svg_file.name
            print(f"  {svg_file.name} ...")
            normalize(str(svg_file), str(out_file))
        print(f"\nDone. {len(svg_files)} files -> {output_path}")
    else:
        if not input_path.exists():
            print(f"Error: File not found: {input_path}", file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)
        print(f"Normalizing officecli SVG -> standard SVG")
        normalize(str(input_path), str(output_path))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

链路：hw_template.pptx  →  officecli (COM+PyMuPDF)  →  .svg  →  svg2pptx  →  .pptx

用法:
    # Step 1: 用 officecli 导出 SVG
    uv run python src/skills/officecli/scripts/pptx2svg.py hw_template.pptx out/ --export-svg --max-slides 3

    # Step 2: 用 svg2pptx 转换回可编辑 PPTX
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg-dir out/svg

    # 单页
    uv run python src/skills/w3slides/scripts/demo_svg2pptx.py --svg out/svg/slide3.svg -o demo.pptx
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

_script_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if sys.path[0] == _script_dir:
    sys.path.pop(0)

from lxml import etree
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Emu
from svg2pptx import SVGConverter

SLIDE_W = 12192000
SLIDE_H = 6858000


def _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path: str) -> str:
    """Preprocess PyMuPDF-generated SVG so svg2pptx can read text positions.

    PyMuPDF generates <text> without x/y, placing them only on <tspan> children,
    and using negative Y values (y-flip coordinate system).
    svg2pptx reads only <text x="..." y="..."> and cannot position text otherwise.
    """
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    # Detect SVG height for y-flip correction
    svg_h = 540.0
    vb = root.get("viewBox", "")
    if vb:
        parts = vb.split()
        if len(parts) == 4:
            try:
                svg_h = float(parts[3])
            except ValueError:
                pass

    for text_el in root.iter(f"{{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}}text"):
        if text_el.get("x") and text_el.get("y"):
            continue

        first_x = None
        first_y = None
        for tspan in text_el.iter(f"{{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}}tspan"):
            xs = tspan.get("x", "")
            ys = tspan.get("y", "")
            if xs and ys:
                try:
                    x_vals = [float(v) for v in xs.split()]
                    y_val = float(ys.split()[0])
                    if first_x is None:
                        first_x = x_vals[0]
                    if first_y is None:
                        first_y = y_val
                except ValueError:
                    continue

        if first_x is not None and first_y is not None:
            if first_y < 0:
                first_y = svg_h + first_y
            text_el.set("x", str(first_x))
            text_el.set("y", str(first_y))

    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".svg", delete=False)
    tree.write(tmp.name, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    tmp.close()
    return tmp.name


def _remove_foreign_objects(svg_path: str) -> str:
    """Remove <foreignObject> elements from SVG (svg2pptx cannot parse them).

    OfficeCLI SVG uses <foreignObject> + HTML for text rendering.
    svg2pptx only handles standard SVG elements.
    """
    tree = etree.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()

    ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    removed = 0
    for fo in root.iter(f"{{{ns}}}foreignObject"):
        parent = fo.getparent()
        if parent is not None:
            parent.remove(fo)
            removed += 1

    if removed > 0:
        print(f"      Preprocess: removed {removed} foreignObject elements (unsupported by svg2pptx)")

    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".svg", delete=False)
    tree.write(tmp.name, encoding="utf-8", xml_declaration=True)
    tmp.close()
    return tmp.name


def svg_to_pptx(svg_path: str, output_path: str, source: str = "pymupdf") -> None:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

    if source == "pymupdf":
        normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
    else:
        normalized = _remove_foreign_objects(svg_path)

    try:
        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
        converter = SVGConverter()
        converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)
    finally:
        os.unlink(normalized)

    prs.save(output_path)
    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name} -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_paths: list[str], output_path: str, source: str = "pymupdf") -> None:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Emu(SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Emu(SLIDE_H)

    for svg_path in svg_paths:
        if source == "pymupdf":
            normalized = _normalize_pymupdf_svg(svg_path)
        else:
            normalized = _remove_foreign_objects(svg_path)

        try:
            slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
            converter = SVGConverter()
            converter.add_to_slide(normalized, slide)
        finally:
            os.unlink(normalized)
        print(f"  {Path(svg_path).name}")

    prs.save(output_path)
    size_kb = Path(output_path).stat().st_size // 1024
    print(f"  -> {output_path} ({size_kb}KB)")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="officecli SVG -> svg2pptx -> editable PPTX (cross-reference demo)"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--svg", help="单个 SVG 文件路径")
    parser.add_argument("--svg-dir", help="SVG 目录路径 (合并所有 .svg)")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", default="demo_svg2pptx_output.pptx")
    parser.add_argument("--source", default="pymupdf", choices=["pymupdf", "officecli"],
                        help="SVG 来源 (default: pymupdf)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.svg_dir:
        svg_dir = Path(args.svg_dir)
        svg_files = sorted(
            str(f) for f in svg_dir.glob("slide[0-9]*.svg")
            if not f.name.endswith("_normalized.svg") and not f.name.endswith("_norm_v2.svg")
        )
        if not svg_files:
            print(f"错误: 目录下无 SVG: {svg_dir}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"SVG -> PPTX ({len(svg_files)} pages, {args.source})")
        svg_to_pptx_multi(svg_files, args.output, args.source)
    elif args.svg:
        svg_path = Path(args.svg)
        if not svg_path.exists():
            print(f"错误: 文件不存在: {svg_path}")
            raise SystemExit(1)
        print(f"SVG -> PPTX (single, {args.source})")
        svg_to_pptx(str(svg_path), args.output, args.source)
    else:
        parser.print_help()
        raise SystemExit(1)

    print(f"\n打开验证: start {args.output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
